Token.title: A short description of struct

description_en: Obtains an access token as part of the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow
description_zh: OAuth2.0授权流程的获取访问令牌
kebab_example: aliyun pds token --grant-type refresh_token --code 0045157fa8e24f4f9a0d9e3ff158c1e0 --redirect-uri https://aliyun.com/pds --client-id 1Zu000flH --client-secret 80D0003i5 --refresh-token 399623e13353490391266c7d48a13ed1 --assertion ey000asd --region cn-hangzhou
name: Token

parameters.help_en:
The grant type. Valid values:

`authorization_code`: Exchanges an authorization code, returned after successful authentication, for an access token.

`refresh_token`: Uses a refresh token from a previous authorization to obtain a new access token.

`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`: Obtains an access token by using a JWT
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型，有以下取值：

authorization_code （通过认证完成后获取的code来换取token）

refresh_token（通过上次授权获取的refresh_token来获取token）

urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer（通过JWT方式获取token）
parameters.name: grant_type

parameters.help_en: The authorization code returned in the redirect URI after successful authentication. This parameter is required when `grant_type` is `authorization_code`
parameters.help_zh: 认证完成后回调地址中携带的code，当grant_type为authorization_code时，此参数必传
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en: The redirect URI used in the authorization request. This parameter is required when `grant_type` is `authorization_code`
parameters.help_zh: 填写发起authorize时传入的redirect_uri，当grant_type为authorization_code时必填
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app you create in the Alibaba Cloud PDS console
parameters.help_zh: 在阿里云PDS控制台申请的App对应的ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The secret of the app you create in the Alibaba Cloud PDS console. This parameter is required for WebServer applications
parameters.help_zh: 在阿里云PDS控制台申请的App对应的Secret，WebServer类型的App必填此参数
parameters.name: client_secret

parameters.help_en: The token used to refresh an access token. This parameter is required when `grant_type` is `refresh_token`
parameters.help_zh: 用于刷新Token的令牌，当grant_type为refresh_token时此参数必传
parameters.name: refresh_token

parameters.help_en: A JWT-signed string that contains user information and authorization parameters to be granted. For the structure, see JWTPayload. This parameter is required when `grant_type` is `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`
parameters.help_zh: 通过JWT私钥签名的字符串，里面包含待授权的用户信息和授权参数，结构参考JWTPayload。当grant_type为urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer时此参数必填
parameters.name: assertion
